ValidationRule.description: Decision log rows are immutable audit records (arch doc 3.3, 8). The one permitted update is the engine stamping Execution_Ref_Id__c blank to populated after submit (6.1 step 11); after that the row is frozen. AMF_Bypass_Log_Lock is the exception.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Permission.AMF_Bypass_Log_Lock), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Execution_Ref_Id__c))), ISBLANK(Execution_Ref_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Record_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Object_API_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Matched_Rule__c), ISCHANGED(Rule_Version__c), ISCHANGED(Selected_Process__c), ISCHANGED(Outcome__c), ISCHANGED(Submitted_By__c), ISCHANGED(Submitted_At__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This decision log row is an immutable audit record. The only permitted change is the framework stamping Execution Ref Id once, immediately after submission. Editing it otherwise requires the AMF Bypass Log Lock permission.
